title: Smoke over the gully — Daren's camp
description: Three fires, a picket line of stolen horses, and men who have stopped bothering to post a proper watch. Daren's gang, fat on the caravan they took. From the ridge you can count them; they cannot count you.

choices.text: Go in hard while they're drunk.

onPass.narration: You come down the gully at a run. The first man to stand up is the first man to fall.

choices.text: Creep in and cut the horses loose first.

onPass.narration: The horses go quietly. When the shouting starts, half the gang is chasing hooves into the dark — the half that stays has no cover and no plan.

onFail.narration: A horse screams. Every head in the camp turns toward you.

choices.text: Mark the place and withdraw. Another night.

onPass.narration: You leave them to their fires and mark the gully on Kael's map. A camp that big does not stay put — sooner or later it walks onto the road, and you will be on it.
